Services

Field testing, verification and operations for liquid cooling.

A liquid-cooled hall can be built by five suppliers and commissioned by none of them. We take the seam: from the facility water interface to the serviceable unit, on systems we supplied and on systems we did not.

Field services · Canada

Commissioning gates and an operations programme for the cooling loop, not the servers.

Four gates, written criteria first

  1. Before dispatch: factory release
  2. Before filling: fill preparation
  3. Before compute: functional readiness
  4. Before handover: system handover

Three operations tiers

  • Tier 1 · Routine care
  • Tier 2 · Verified readiness
  • Tier 3 · Lifecycle support

We write the test specification and the acceptance criteria, train and qualify the field teams, and hold the records. Licensed and insured partner companies perform the regulated site work to that specification.
